description: Enterprise-grade Notion workspace integration for RailCall. Governed query, page, block, and database operations with signed airlock receipts. Tag: contest:2026Q3

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search workspace pages and databases by text query with filter options.

query.description: Text query string to match titles and content.

filter_value.description: Filter results by object type ('page' or 'database').

page_size.description: Number of results to return (1-100, default: 20).

commands.name: get_page
commands.description: Retrieve page metadata and property details for a given page ID.

page_id.description: The unique UUID of the Notion page.

commands.name: query_database
commands.description: Query a Notion database with structured filters, sorting, and pagination.

database_id.description: The unique UUID of the Notion database.

page_size.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-100, default: 50).

commands.name: get_block_children
commands.description: Retrieve child content blocks of a parent page or container block.

block_id.description: The ID of the parent page or block.

page_size.description: Maximum child blocks to retrieve (1-100, default: 50).

commands.name: get_database
commands.description: Retrieve database schema definition including all columns, types, and options.

database_id.description: The unique UUID of the Notion database.

commands.name: create_page
commands.description: Create a new page inside a parent database or parent page.

parent_id.description: UUID of the parent database or page.

properties.description: Key-value dictionary of page properties matching the database schema.

icon_emoji.description: Single emoji character for the page icon (e.g. '🚀').

cover_url.description: Public HTTP URL for page cover image.

content_blocks.description: List of simple content blocks to insert into page body on creation.

commands.name: update_page
commands.description: Update properties, title, or icon of an existing Notion page.

page_id.description: UUID of the page to update.

properties.description: Dictionary of property updates matching database schema.

archived.description: Set to true to archive, false to unarchive.

commands.name: append_blocks
commands.description: Append structured content blocks (paragraphs, headings, callouts, code, to-dos) to a page.

block_id.description: UUID of the parent page or block to append children to.

blocks.description: List of simplified or raw Notion block objects to append.

commands.name: update_block
commands.description: Update the content, text, or checked state of a specific Notion block.

text.description: New text content for the block.

checked.description: Checked state if block type is 'to_do'.

commands.name: archive_page
commands.description: Archive (soft-delete) or restore a Notion page or database item.

page_id.description: UUID of the page to archive or restore.

archive.description: true to archive, false to restore (default: true).
